user.title: Water heating system
user.description: Choose how domestic hot water is produced. WaterSteer uses this to select the appropriate control model.

data_description.system_type: Choose a standalone water heater or a heat pump with integrated domestic hot water.

sensors.title: Input sensors
sensors.description: Select the Home Assistant entities WaterSteer will use as its primary inputs.

data_description.dhw_temperature_entity: Sensor that represents the current domestic hot water temperature.
data_description.electricity_price_entity: Sensor that represents the current electricity price. Future price data will be added by the price planner.
data_description.occupancy_entity: Optional binary sensor, input boolean, or person entity used only to refine learned DHW demand. WaterSteer also works without occupancy data.
data_description.external_heating_entity: For example an iBoost or immersion heater. While it is on, WaterSteer does not preheat.

thresholds.title: DHW temperature thresholds
thresholds.description: Temperature limits for the hot water tank, lowest first. Comfort always wins over price.

data_description.absolute_minimum: At or below this temperature WaterSteer requests immediate forced heating.
data_description.comfort_minimum: Below this temperature WaterSteer requests comfort recovery even if electricity is expensive.
data_description.normal_target: At or above this temperature stored hot water is considered sufficient, so heating may be held for cheaper electricity.
data_description.precharge_target: Target when heating ahead of an expensive period. Cheap electricity alone never triggers heating.
data_description.min_thermal_confidence: WaterSteer will not hold or block normal DHW production until thermal learning confidence reaches this percentage. Default: 50%.
data_description.max_hold_hours: Longest time WaterSteer may request that DHW production is held. After this, it requests normal operation for at least one hour.
data_description.comfort_escalation_minutes: If the tank stays below the comfort minimum this long without warming up, WaterSteer escalates to force_heat.

standalone_control.title: Standalone water heater
standalone_control.description: Optional. Select the switch WaterSteer may control when Mode is set to Active control.

data_description.standalone_control_switch: Switch that enables the water heater when ON. WaterSteer only switches it in Active control mode.
data_description.standalone_power_sensor: Optional power sensor for the water heater. This can later help WaterSteer distinguish commanded operation from actual heating.

heat_pump_control.title: Heat pump domestic hot water
heat_pump_control.description: Optional. Select the entities WaterSteer may switch when Mode is set to Active control. Leave empty to only get recommendations.

data_description.heat_pump_dhw_active_entity: Optional advanced signal. Select this only if your heat-pump integration exposes an entity that indicates actual DHW production. Many heat pumps do not provide this signal.
data_description.block_entity: Switch or input boolean that blocks hot water production when ON.
data_description.extra_hot_water_entity: Switch or input boolean that starts extra hot water when ON.

error.invalid_threshold_order: Temperature thresholds must be ordered: absolute minimum < comfort minimum < normal target < precharge target.

init.description: Change WaterSteer inputs and system type. The integration reloads automatically after the configuration is saved.
